nuggets.text: Dave Canales played defensive back as a high school junior, then switched to quarterback and made first-team all-league at both.
Tetairoa McMillan was the 2025 Offensive Rookie of the Year, joining Cam Newton as the only Panthers to win it.
Tetairoa McMillan set the Panthers record for receiving yards by a rookie in 2025.
Bryce Young has 12 fourth-quarter comebacks, the most of any NFL quarterback over the last three seasons.
Bryce Young threw for 448 yards in a 2025 overtime win over Atlanta, breaking Cam Newton's Panthers single-game record.
The Panthers won the 2025 NFC South with an 8-9 record and made the playoffs for the first time since 2017.
The Panthers played their first season, 1995, at Clemson's Memorial Stadium while their Charlotte stadium was being built.
The Panthers' "Keep Pounding" motto comes from a speech linebacker Sam Mills gave the team before a 2003 playoff game.
Sir Purr has been the Panthers mascot since their very first season, and wears a No. 00 jersey.
The Panthers' stadium is guarded by six bronze panther statues called "Indomitable Spirit," each with green eyes.
